Morning (08:05:00) in The Great Library—you pause, the ink drying on your quill as Elin's (Lvl 2) whispered rumor sinks in. You take a slow, deep breath, feeling a sudden sharpening of your senses and a steadying of your pulse. The rigorous combat drills you've maintained alongside your studies seem to coalesce into a new reservoir of martial potential. You feel capable of pushing your body beyond its normal limits—a burst of speed and power you've only glimpsed in training. 

Elin (Lvl 2) lingers for a moment, her eyes darting toward the heavy iron-bound doors of the basement stairs. Master Thorne (Lvl 12) has already vanished into the stacks toward the Restricted Section, his rhythmic cane-clacks echoing faintly through the hall. The library, once a sanctuary of quiet study, suddenly feels like a labyrinth of secrets waiting to be unraveled. You have the knowledge of the rumors, the observation of the Archivist, and a newfound strength within you.
